text:
R&D Lead: FYI 1: rolling out a new staged-rollout policy and a short stability window next week. TL;DR: tighter canary caps + an explicit escalation ladder. please ack if you have deployments touching serving or routing.
Tara B.: can you summarise the key changes?
R&D Lead: sure 1 key points: 1) Stability window: Thu 2026-08-12 16:00-22:00 UTC (no risky rollouts). 2) Staged-rollout policy: mandatory 3-step progression (1%, 5%, 20%) with automated hold between steps. 3) Safety throttle: auto-pause on error uplift and forced rollback rules.
deploy-bot: notice: stability_window scheduled 2026-08-12T16:00:00Z -> 2026-08-12T22:00:00Z. Scheduler will block non-exempt risky deploys.
Sanjay M.: approval path for exceptions? we sometimes need last-minute hotfixes.
R&D Lead: exception path: file a short exemption in #eng-releases with owner, urgency, mitigation, rollback one-liner, and required approvers (security or infra). Target review time: 2 hours.
Liam F.: what's the automated hold logic between steps?
R&D Lead: progression rules: start at 1% for 20min, if metrics OK -> move to 5% for 30min, then 20% for 60min. Each step has an auto-hold: if error uplift > threshold for the step, the rollout pauses and pages oncall.
ops-oncall: thresholds: 1% step: 3.0% error uplift triggers pause; 5% step: 2.0%; 20% step: 1.0%. Pause windows: evaluate over 10m sliding window. If paused and no owner action in 12m, ops will rollback.
Tara B.: can you paste a config snippet teams should put in PRs?
R&D Lead: snippet for PR body (add as code block): ```json
{"staged_rollout": {"steps": ["1%:20m","5%:30m","20%:60m"], "thresholds": {"1%": 3.0, "5%": 2.0, "20%": 1.0}, "pause_window_mins": 10, "owner_response_mins": 12, "auto_rollback": true}}
```
Sanjay M.: ops will centrally enforce these values during the stability window?
ops-oncall: yes 1: scheduler and release-runner will enforce caps and auto-hold behaviour. Teams must include `release.owner` and `release.rollback_one_liner` in PR body or scheduler will block.
Liam F.: monitoring requirements? we had incidents where releases lacked proper checks.
R&D Lead: new minimum monitoring: two verification queries (latency p95 and error rate) plus an SLO baseline snapshot. Add `release.monitoring` section in PR with queries and expected thresholds.
Tara B.: example one-liner rollback to include?
R&D Lead: example: `rollback: rctl deploy --service ranking --tag stable-v3` keep it short.
deploy-bot: note: added policy_flag "enforce_staged_rollout" for next week's runs.
ops-oncall: rota: increased coverage for Thu night; one infra lead + one runtime lead on pager. Owners, please add pager contact in PRs.
R&D Lead: final: if you have ongoing canaries/experiments, post name + current traffic % here by EOD. We'll produce a safelist and notify owners with required caps. A short KB + pinned note will appear in #eng-notices in ~30m. :memo: 
Tara B.: ACK 1: I have "ranker-experiment-a" at 4% 1 will cap to 1% during the stability window and add the PR fields now.
Sanjay M.: ACK. I have a small infra patch scheduled but it doesn't touch serving; will still file exemption to be safe.
R&D Lead: thanks all. we'll publish the official checklist and the scheduler-enforced template shortly.
